description: Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - The Mediation Boards Act, No. 72 of 1988 - Order under Section 4
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Justice exercising powers under the Mediation Boards Act (No. 72 of 1988) to specify which Divisional Secretary's Divisions will be subject to the Act's provisions. The content focuses on establishing the legal/regulatory framework for mediation board operations in specific administrative areas, making it primarily a regulatory matter under existing legislation. While a minister is named, the notification does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather the implementation of a legal act.
